title: Le Rustique Restaurant
tagline: Mediterranean fine dining at the foot of Mount Kenya
description:
Le Rustique is Nanyuki's Mediterranean fine dining room, set in a Moroccan-inspired garden manor with open fire, flagstone floors, and al fresco terraces. The kitchen works organic and artisan ingredients into modern Mediterranean plates, backed by a considered wine list for long highland lunches and evenings.


Quick highlights:

  • Breakfast, lunch, and dinner every day of the week

  • Indoor fireplace dining plus shaded outdoor tables

  • On-site deli and cheese bar for take-home tastes

  • Poolside cocktails a short walk from the restaurant

  • Reservations recommended for weekend dinner

title: Le Rustique Hotel
tagline: Garden cottages with Mount Kenya air and a heated pool
description:
Le Rustique Hotel offers a handful of spacious garden cottages on the quiet southern edge of Nanyuki. Guests stay steps from the Mediterranean restaurant, heated pool, gift shop, and massage parlour, with Mount Kenya framing the lawns.


Quick highlights:

  • Around 10 cottage-style rooms in a Zen garden setting

  • Heated outdoor pool and lounge seating

  • Restaurant, deli, and spa services on the same grounds

  • Ideal base for Ol Pejeta and equator day trips

  • Book directly for breakfast-inclusive rates

details.house_rules: Quiet hours after 22:00. No smoking indoors. Pets by prior arrangement. Photo ID required at check-in.
details.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in
details.host_bio: A small highland hospitality team focused on warm service, garden calm, and Mediterranean hospitality.

title: Nanyuki Equator Marker
tagline: Stand on the line and watch the Coriolis demo
address: A2 Equator Marker, south of Nanyuki town
description:
The equator marker on the A2 south of Nanyuki is a classic highland stop. Travellers pose on the painted line, browse curio stalls, and often watch a local Coriolis water demonstration that makes the geography feel real.


Quick highlights:

  • Photo stop right on the equator line

  • Local Coriolis force demonstration for tips

  • Curio and craft market beside the highway

  • Easy add-on between Nairobi and Nanyuki

  • Best in clear morning light for mountain views

title: Frontiers Friday Garden Dinner
tagline: Highland supper under the trees at One Stop
address: One Stop Nanyuki, near Nanyuki Airstrip
description:
Frontiers at One Stop Nanyuki is the garden café and meeting place beside the airstrip. Friday evenings bring longer dinners, wood-fired pizza energy, and a relaxed highland crowd under Mount Kenya skies.


Quick highlights:

  • Garden tables with Mount Kenya views

  • Barista coffee by day, full bar by night

  • Pizza oven and seasonal kitchen plates

  • Easy stop for travellers landing at Nanyuki airstrip

  • Walkable to Butterbean Farm Shop next door

details.organiser: Frontiers Bar and Restaurant, One Stop Nanyuki

title: Le Rustique Spa & Wellness
tagline: Massage, yoga studio calm, and poolside recovery
description:
Le Rustique's spa and wellness corner pairs massage treatments with a quiet yoga studio and heated pool access. It is designed for travellers and locals who want to reset between safari days without leaving the garden.


Quick highlights:

  • Massage parlour on the hotel grounds

  • Yoga studio for private or small sessions

  • Heated pool for post-treatment recovery

  • Same-day bookings when diaries allow

  • Combine with lunch at the Mediterranean restaurant

deals.title: Hotel guest add-on
deals.note: Ask reception for spa package rates

title: PCEA Nanyuki Spinners and Weavers
tagline: Handwoven rugs and textiles made in Nanyuki
address: PCEA Nanyuki Spinners and Weavers, Nanyuki
description:
PCEA Nanyuki Spinners and Weavers has trained women artisans in Nanyuki since 1977. The workshop turns highland inspiration into handwoven rugs, throws, and home textiles you can buy directly from the makers.


Quick highlights:

  • Founded in 1977 with 280+ women trained

  • Rugs, throws, and apparel woven on site

  • Direct support for artisan livelihoods

  • Call ahead to visit the workshop

  • Wholesale and custom orders welcome

details.specialty: Handwoven rugs, throws, and home textiles
details.return_policy: Exchanges for unused items within 7 days when receipt is shown. Custom pieces are final sale.

title: 4-Bed Solar Townhouse with Mt Kenya Views
tagline: Solar townhouse near the equator with train access
address: Near Equator, about 13 km from Nanyuki town, Laikipia
description:
A solid 4-bedroom solar townhouse near the equator outside Nanyuki, listed publicly at KES 10,000,000. The home faces Mount Kenya, runs on solar, and sits about 1 km from a train station for Friday Nairobi runs.


Quick highlights:

  • Asking price KES 10,000,000

  • 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms with mountain balconies

  • Solar power plus 3,000-litre water storage

  • Cabro parking for up to six cars

  • Stone perimeter wall with electric fence

title: Trout Tree Restaurant
tagline: Farm-to-table trout in a sacred fig tree
address: Burguret River, off Kiganjo-Nanyuki Road, near Naro Moru
description:
Trout Tree Restaurant is built in and around a huge Mugumo fig tree on the Burguret River. Fresh rainbow trout come straight from the ponds below, with Laikipia beef, vegetarian plates, and weekend pizza when the oven is fired. Colobus monkeys and tree hyrax share the canopy with lunch guests.


Quick highlights:

  • Open Tuesday to Sunday, roughly 10:00 to 16:00

  • Fresh trout smoked, grilled, or curried from on-site ponds

  • Seats up to about 60 guests across tree decks

  • Resident colobus monkeys and rich bird life

  • Reserve ahead for weekend groups. Call John on +254 726 281 704

title: Naro Moru River Lodge
tagline: Rustic ecolodge on 71 acres beneath Mount Kenya
address: Naro Moru, Off Nyeri-Nanyuki Highway, Kenya
description:
Naro Moru River Lodge is a rustic mountain ecolodge on a 71-acre stream-fed enclave about 16 km south of the equator. It is a classic base for Mount Kenya climbs, birding, and slow riverside days with colobus in the trees.


Quick highlights:

  • River views, gardens, and year-round outdoor pool

  • Strong bird-watching site with montane forest trails

  • Mountain climbing packages with experienced desks

  • Restaurant, bar, and campfire evenings

  • Nairobi sales line +254 117 240 936

details.house_rules: Respect wildlife corridors. Quiet hours after 22:00. No feeding monkeys. Firewood only in designated pits.
details.host_bio: A long-running mountain lodge team helping climbers, families, and school groups explore Mount Kenya with care.

title: Mount Kenya Climb via Naro Moru Route
tagline: Classic trek to Point Lenana from Naro Moru
address: Naro Moru Gate, Mount Kenya National Park
description:
The Naro Moru Route is one of Mount Kenya's classic approaches to Point Lenana. Climbs are arranged through local lodge desks with mountain guides, porters, and park logistics for 3 to 5 day itineraries.


Quick highlights:

  • 3 to 5 day itineraries to Point Lenana

  • Guided climbs with porter support options

  • Base in Naro Moru before and after the trek

  • Suitable for fit hikers with altitude prep

  • Book via Naro Moru River Lodge reservations

title: Naro Moru River Lodge Team Building Weekend
tagline: Forest team challenges with mountain air
address: Naro Moru River Lodge, Off Nyeri-Nanyuki Highway
description:
A weekend team building package on the Naro Moru River Lodge grounds. Groups use forest trails, pool lawns, and experiential challenges, then regroup for lodge meals and campfire debriefs under Mount Kenya.


Quick highlights:

  • Two-day experiential programme on 71 acres

  • Suitable for corporate teams and school groups

  • Meals and lodging packages available

  • Nairobi sales desk for group quotes

  • Combine with a gentle nature walk or birding hour

Quick highlights:

  • Porter and guide packaging on request

  • School trip and corporate trek logistics

  • Same-property lodging before departure

  • Sales and reservations lines answered daily

tagline: Farm café coffee with Mount Kenya lawn views
description:
Root North Farmshop & Cafe sits on the A2 in Timau with lawns facing Mount Kenya. It is a slow coffee stop for travellers and locals, known for rich Kenyan coffee, bakery treats, steak pies, and easy outdoor seating with a small playground.


Quick highlights:

title: Olepangi Farm

description:
Olepangi Farm is a boutique ecolodge and working farm in Timau, repeatedly recognised by Condé Nast Traveller readers. Guests come for farm-to-table hospitality, highland views, and easy access to Ngare Ndare and Lewa country.


Quick highlights:

  • Boutique farm cottages with thoughtful interiors

  • Farm-led meals and relaxed lounge spaces

  • Reservations +254 742 148 815 or +254 704 438 840

  • Strong base for Ngare Ndare Forest day trips

details.house_rules: Advance booking required. Quiet farm hours after 21:30. Children welcome with notice. Respect grazing and wildlife buffers.
details.host_bio: A Timau farm hospitality team focused on warm service, seasonal cooking, and conservation-minded stays.

title: Ngare Ndare Forest
tagline: Canopy walk, blue pools, and elephant corridor forest
address: Ngare Ndare Forest Gate, 11 km from Timau turn-off
description:
Ngare Ndare Forest is a lush indigenous forest on the northern foothills of Mount Kenya near Timau. Visitors come for the 450 m canopy walkway, azure waterfall pools, birding, and a living elephant corridor linking Mount Kenya to Lewa.


Quick highlights:

  • Book at least 3 days ahead via bookings@ngarendare.org or 0700 412 532

  • 450 m canopy walk about 30 feet above the forest floor

  • Six natural blue pools and waterfall swimming spots

  • Over 200 bird species plus Big Five possibilities

  • 4WD recommended for the waterfall track

details.min_age: All ages with care on canopy walk

title: Ngare Ndare Forest Day Out
tagline: Canopy walk Saturday with blue pool swim time
description:
A booked Saturday forest day with Ngare Ndare Forest Trust. Arrive early for cooler wildlife hours, walk the canopy bridge, hike to the azure pools, and support community conservation around Timau.


Quick highlights:

  • Pre-booked entry only. Contact the trust first

  • Best arrival window 08:00 to 10:00

  • Canopy walk plus waterfall pool swim

  • Trained guides available on site

  • Weekend office hours end at 13:00 for bookings

title: Ngare Ndare Guided Forest Walks
tagline: Booked guides for canopy, pools, and camping

Ngare Ndare Forest Trust trains guides who lead canopy walks, 3.5 km forest hikes to the waterfalls, birding circuits, and campsite stays. Bookings keep visits orderly and fund community conservation around Timau.


Quick highlights:

  • Advance booking required for guides and entry

  • Canopy walk, waterfall hike, and camping support

  • Mon to Sat booking window, shorter on weekends

  • Email bookings@ngarendare.org or call 0700 412 532
